item.title: Pamir Spinel: Colour and Treatment
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Kuh-i-Lal in the Pamir mountains of Tajikistan is a source of pink spinel. Photoluminescence spectroscopy can help distinguish heated from unheated spinel.
EXIMUTC view: Attractive colour and geographic origin do not replace a documented treatment assessment.
Source: www.ssef.ch https://www.ssef.ch/heated-spinel-from-tajikistan/
Photo: Greg Polley / Smithsonian NMNH, CC0
